subject: ACME: shortfall signal and explicit owner matrix for Q4 pipeline coverage
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kerry Nolan <kerry@acmetech.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: ACME: shortfall signal and explicit owner matrix for Q4 pipeline coverage

Team — quick flag from finance: attached is the Q4 snapshot for ACME. We are at ~0.48x coverage to the Q4 ARR target for this deal segment (mid-market), which translates to a projected shortfall of ~$1.2M ARR if nothing changes.

Immediate asks:
- Stage confirmations: update stage and confidence for any ACME-related opportunities in HubSpot by EOD Friday (11/10). Put clear rationale if you move a deal backward.
- Owner matrix: I want an explicit owner for each opportunity that can reasonably be pulled into commit. If you claim commit, confirm customer signals and expected close week.
- Risk calls: flag any legal/procurement blockers (Kerry, cc'd) that could push the timeline beyond month-end.

Attached: Q4_pipe_snapshot_ACME.xlsx (sheet: summary + deal-level notes). I added an initial color-coded risk column. Marcus — can you produce the owner matrix and a short notes column for quick finance sign-off? Rishi — will need your conservative vs. optimistic recognition guidance once we see owners. Laura/Ben — please align on commercial concessions if we need to accelerate.

I'll collate responses and circulate the action log. Thanks,

— Olga
Olga Petrov
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_pipe_snapshot_ACME.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME: shortfall signal and explicit owner matrix for Q4 pipeline coverage

Olga — thanks for the heads-up. I've pulled the open ACME opportunities and attached a draft owner matrix (commit_owner_matrix.csv). Key notes:
- Two mid-market deals (ACME-MID-17, ACME-MID-21) currently in "Verbal" stage. Sales view: 60%/70% confidence respectively; customer has approved PO language but procurement needs final SOW sign-off.
- One ARR-heavy deal (ACME-ENT-05) that was previously counted in commit is now flagged by CS for scope reduction — likely to drop ~$350k if scope isn't restored.
- Suggested immediate actions: schedule procurement sync with Kerry (copied) and re-run legal on redlines this week; escalate ENT-05 to AE + CSM for product scope reconciliation.

I've added owner assignments in the CSV and a short notes column with the most recent customer signal (email snippets). Will maintain this doc and update after each call.

On Fri EOD I'll produce a summarized commit-only list for finance, but we should align on the 'conservative commit' set beforehand.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commit_owner_matrix.csv (CSV)

Team — quick finance note on approach:
- Conservative recognition: mark only deals with signed PO or DocuSign executed by 11/30 as commit. For borderline verbal + PO-needed opportunities, treat as "high-probability" (for internal tracking) but do not include in official commit until DocuSign is executed.
- For the snapshot, I'm attaching a version with two columns: "finance_commit" (Y/N) and "confidence_note". If you set finance_commit=Y, include the close week and cite the primary signal (e.g., fully-executed PO, payments confirmed, procurement email).

From initial pass:
- ACME-MID-17: current sales confidence 60% — recommend finance_commit=N unless we get a signed PO by 11/14.
- ACME-MID-21: fast-moving; Marcus to confirm procurement availability this week.
- ACME-ENT-05: treat as partial (only the currently scoped items with executed SOWs).

I'll review the rollout of any concessions or credits with revenue ops before we agree to accelerate recognition. If anybody wants finance to take a call with procurement (Kerry), ping and we'll join.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_pipe_snapshot_ACME_finance_view.xlsx (spreadsheet)
